required_capture: Account-scoped ProtoOASymbolByIdRes plus symbol-name/asset resolution and capture time.
Opening and closing ProtoOADeal/partial fills, quantities, settled fees, swap and deposit-currency conversion.
Decision and dispatch bid/ask, side, quantity and timestamps for both legs; actual order/ack/fill identity.

statement_evidence.qualification: Deduplicated statement closing deals, not full positions. No dispatch quotes or separated historical swap rates; no cost model inferred.

methodology: first non-crossed quote at/after checkpoint within5s; both recorded sides age<=6s; grouped millisecond updates; exact type7 quantiles; bps=20000*(ask-bid)/(ask+bid)
